title: Epic Title Menu
description: This project redoes your whole GUI, originally just being the for the buttons on the title menu.
body:
This is a pretty simple resource pack. You don't like how the gui looks? Then this is THE Minecraft resource pack for you! Love them textures? Well now you can do that with GOD156's very own GUI resource pack!

Also the discord is not dedicated to this resource pack. It is used for other things too. Please ping the owner and clearly state you're there for the resource pack. Report bugs and make suggestions in the discord. 😉
